channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kevin Durant | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kevin Durant from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Kevin Durant, Kyrie Irving
item.description:
Masai Ujiri:

“Kyrie Irving is one of the finest basketball players to ever walk around the world. I remember Kevin Durant saying there is only one Kyrie walking around the world. I am blessed to have had a relationship with him. Now we find ourselves on the same team. He is coming off injury, but he has had an incredible summer. He is right back at it. His spirit, you can tell he is a very passionate dude. He thinks differently, but inside, Kyrie is a great dude, a great person. All the young players look up to him. He is such a kind person around employees, around everybody.”

Masai Ujiri on Kevin Durant, Kyrie Irving, Oct 17, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Evan Turner on LeBron James, Kevin Durant, Jalen Williams
item.description:
Turner continued to say of James.

“You look at the starting five. I don’t see him slowing down. Who’s better? I mean, who’s better? It’s almost like the Stefon Diggs thing. If I’m not the better one, who’s a better number two than me that’s just elite? I think Jalen Williams from OKC is one of the best top 15 players in the world, and I would throw ‘Bron up against him any night. Jalen Williams is elite. LeBron has got five or 10 more years the same way with Kevin Durant. They’re like, ‘Where am I going?’ There’s nothing else to do. This shit is easy.”

Evan Turner on LeBron James, Kevin Durant, Jalen Williams, Oct 15, 2026. Source: rotogrinders.com.

item.title: Rafael Stone on Kevin Durant
item.description:
Rafael Stone on the expectations for Kevin Durant in Houston:

“Obviously when you trade for somebody of Kevin Durant's stature, it's very important that you have good conversations coming in about expectations. And he understood coming in that this wasn't going to be a situation where we're trading for him and now we're going to go get 75 veteran players to play with him, which sometimes happens, but it's not like that has a great track record of success. And so, he understood that he was coming in to play with a bunch of younger guys and that the team was probably going to look the way it looks now. And it has. And is best I can tell, you guys can ask him, but he really enjoys them.”

Rafael Stone on Kevin Durant, Oct 9, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Pat Spencer on Kevin Durant, Cam Spencer
item.description:
Suns guard Pat Spencer on brother, Grizzlies guard Cam Spencer, talking trash to Kevin Durant:

“Tremendous respect for people who have competed at a high level, but when you step between those lines, we really don't give a shit who you are. It's more so about trying to win the game. It's not personal. Some guys take it personally, but we don't. Everything is fair game.”

Pat Spencer on Kevin Durant, Cam Spencer, Sep 29, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Iman Shumpert on Kevin Durant
item.description:
Iman Shumpert on Kevin Durant:

“Even though he went and joined some people that already came from winning and they had established a record, they needed him or they couldn't beat us (Cavaliers) again. I feel that way.”

Iman Shumpert on Kevin Durant, Sep 25, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Marcus Smart on Kevin Durant
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Marcus Smart on playing with Kevin Durant:

“I get to be on the other side of him taking the shots and not taking the shots over me...his ability to make shots it doesn't matter who's there. And it also doesn't help that he's close to seven foot, and I'm close to six foot. And he just shoots right on top of me, so to be able to pass him the ball and go, okay now I get to actually watch the shot and not have to worry about trying to make a miss... I think that's gonna be the fascinating part to be able to watch him do what he does best”

Marcus Smart on Kevin Durant, Sep 22, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Rafael Stone on Kevin Durant
item.description:
ClutchFans: Rafael Stone on Kevin Durant:

“He's actually like, probably the easiest, along with Yao, maybe the easiest guy of that stature that I've ever been around in the NBA. He just wants to hoop.”

Rafael Stone on Kevin Durant, Sep 22, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jabari Smith Jr on Kevin Durant
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't:Jabari Smith Jr on what to expect from the Rockets next season:

“I think you're gonna see a team that is a little bit more used to playing with each other. We added Kevin Durant last year, just gotta adjust to playing with him...obviously anybody can play with him. Just tendencies, getting Fred back will be huge for us. And I think you'll just see everybody older, obviously a lot better, more mature. See a lot better team next year for sure”

Jabari Smith Jr on Kevin Durant, Aug 8, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Maverick Carter on LeBron James, Kevin Durant
item.description:
Maverick Carter:

“I left Nike in '06 to work to be full-time with LeBron. LeBron had an agent at the time, fired his agent. The same one Kevin (Durant) fired soon after. And we started a company to manage LeBron. And frankly, I didn't know what the f*ck I was doing, the truth. I mean, I knew the only thing I knew is I had to get smart people. I knew the buckets, like we need some legal, we need accounting. I knew those things and I knew how to find people.”

Maverick Carter on LeBron James, Kevin Durant, Jul 27, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Keaton Wagler on Kevin Durant
item.description:
Keaton Wagler:

“When I get there, I can't wait to play against Kevin Durant. He's one of the best scorers I've ever seen and being able to see that in person live and get to go up against him is going to be, you know, it's going to be a crazy experience.”

Keaton Wagler on Kevin Durant, Jul 1, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Nick Young on Kevin Durant
item.description:
Nick Young:

“Steph and Kevin Durant was fighting over Finals MVP,that's about it. You could tell they both was trying to get it without saying they trying to get it. Kevin Durant was taking it a little easy, I felt like, and Steph wasn't having that good of a game that game. So Kevin Durant just had to turn it up. And I think that's when he won Finals MVP too, after that game. It was a big night for him.”

Nick Young on Kevin Durant, Jun 21, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Draymond Green on Andre Iguodala, Kevin Durant, Andrew Bogut, Klay Thompson
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“Who are your top three defensive teammates of all time? Andrew Bogut number one, Klay Thompson number two. Klay Thompson, ball hawk. And I'd say number three, number three, my favorite defensive teammate of all time, or not favorite, but top three. Kevin Durant was elite defensively here. Elite. Andre Iguodala. Andre Iguodala made the game really easy. Got to go with Andre. It has to be Andre.”

Draymond Green on Andre Iguodala, Kevin Durant, Andrew Bogut, Klay Thompson, Jun 1, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: David Fizdale on Kevin Durant
item.description:
David Fizdale on LeBron’s crazy work ethic as a member of the Miami Heat:

“Kevin Durant is the most relentless worker I’ve seen on the court, but LeBron’s body of work in a day, unmatched. I’d get to the office at 6 am. A guy rides in on a 10 speed with black tights and helmet with glasses. I’m like ‘who is this guy in our garage?’ He takes off the helmet, it’s Bron. He rolled into work on a bike and got his conditioning in. He rode miles into work, full sweat at 6 am. I’d meet him on the court and do a full other hour. Then we practice. Then he lifts. Then does all this stuff to prepare his body. By the time he leaves, his kids are getting out of school.”

David Fizdale on Kevin Durant, May 9, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Draymond Green on Kevin Durant
item.description:
Draymond on Kevin Durant leaving the Suns:

“Let's not put this all on Kevin like Kevin's not great cause Kevin is great and there will be no Kevin slander on my watch. Kevin'steam wasn't fighting to get in. Kevin is doing just fine and they doing just fine. I think when you look at the situation I think it benefited for both teams for Kevin to leave here. I think it benefited Houston and I think it benefited the Suns”

Draymond Green on Kevin Durant, Apr 18, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jake LaRavia on Kevin Durant
item.description:
Jake LaRavia on the challenge of facing Kevin Durant:

“I always take those challenges with pride and, obviously guarded him in the matchups that we've had previously. He's one of the greatest scorers ever, so, it'll be very exciting for me to, you know, take that challenge.”

Jake LaRavia on Kevin Durant, Apr 14, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jake LaRavia on Kevin Durant
item.description:
Jake LaRavia on having to guard Kevin Durant:

“I always take those challenges with pride. Obviously guarded him in the matchups we had previously. He’s one of the greatest scorers ever so it will be every exciting for me to take that challenge”

Jake LaRavia on Kevin Durant, Apr 14, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tyler Herro on Kevin Durant
item.description:
Tyler Herro on his back and forth with Kevin Durant:

“Nothing crazy. I know Kevin a little bit. Just competing. I feel like as a team, we didn't have an edge to us in Milwaukee or Philly. So I was just trying to bring another edge to it.”

Tyler Herro on Kevin Durant, Feb 28, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Dillon Brooks on Kevin Durant
item.description:
“They wanted to keep me to build more and more to that franchise. But overall, when you got a guy like Kevin Durant, you cannot pass up on it. And they're doing well. They haven't fell off -- like Memphis did.”

Dillon Brooks on Kevin Durant, Jan 15, 2026. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Bill Self on Kevin Durant
item.description:
Self said.

“Good gosh. If they’re going to try to play in historic college venues, why wouldn’t the NBA want to be here? I know KD (Kevin Durant) said at one time that this was the best place that he’d ever played. So I don’t know if that still holds true, but I would think that would be a great option.”

Bill Self on Kevin Durant, Dec 29, 2025. Source: Kansas City Star.

item.title: Tari Eason on Kevin Durant
item.description:
Tari Eason on the Kevin Durant trade to Houston:

“My first reaction was sh*t am I still on the team?”

Tari Eason on Kevin Durant, Oct 17, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: AJ Dybantsa on Kevin Durant
item.description:
AJ Dybantsa:

“Bro, Kevin Durant was my favorite player since I started watching them play. For real? Yeah. Why, bro? You just—easy buckets. Like just easy. He just make it look so easy. Just like the fluidity of his game. Yeah. Like he don’t make it look too hard. Two, three dribbles, get you in your spot. Like that’s what a real professional look like. He not trying to do too much. He just go get to his stuff.”

AJ Dybantsa on Kevin Durant, Oct 14, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Devin Booker on Kevin Durant, Bradley Beal
item.description:
Devin Booker on two-year run with Kevin Durant and Bradley Beal:

“It was tough. I think just not getting to where we wanted to with Kevin and Brad, two guys that I have a high respect for and always will. The opportunity to play alongside with them was a lot in its own, but it will always be a disappointment to me to not do what we all sought out to do.”

Devin Booker on Kevin Durant, Bradley Beal, Sep 25, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mat Ishbia on Kevin Durant, Dillon Brooks
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Ishbia:

“We made the Kevin Durant trade, Dillon was a target. Dillon is exactly what we're talking about. He's the kind of guy we want here. Defensive minded, tough, sticks up for his teammates”

Mat Ishbia on Kevin Durant, Dillon Brooks, Sep 24, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Nikola Jovic on Kevin Durant, Milos Teodosic
item.description:
Reflecting on his childhood, he named Kevin Durant as one of his biggest international idols, while Miloš Teodosić stood out from the domestic scene.

“I had the chance to be part of the team during a national team window when Teodosic played. At that time, I wasn’t ready to get significant minutes, and I regret not having the opportunity to play alongside him. As for Durant, I now have the chance to face him in the NBA,”

Nikola Jovic on Kevin Durant, Milos Teodosic, Aug 14, 2025. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Austin Rivers on LeBron James, Kobe Bryant, Kevin Durant, Carmelo Anthony, Michael Jordan, Allen Iverson, James Harden
item.description:
Fullcourtpass: Austin Rivers on scoring in the NBA

“LeBron James doesn’t have half the offensive bag that Kevin [Durant]has…I would say Kevin Durant, Carmelo Anthony, James Harden, Kobe Bryant, Michael Jordan, and Allen Iverson are the best scorers I’ve ever seen”

Austin Rivers on LeBron James, Kobe Bryant, Kevin Durant, Carmelo Anthony, Michael Jordan, Allen Iverson, James Harden, Aug 13, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Simone Fontecchio on Kevin Durant
item.description:
The Italian wing revealed in the interview that after he arrived in Detroit, he received an unexpected sign of respect from one of the best players in the league, Kevin Durant.

“I was just got traded to the Pistons, and one of the first few games that I played with Detroit was against Phoenix, where Kevin Durant was playing at that time”

Simone Fontecchio on Kevin Durant, Jul 8, 2025. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Rudy Tomjanovich on Kevin Durant
item.description:
Hall of Famer Rudy Tomjanovich on future Hall of Famer Kevin Durant ( @KDTrey5 ) joining the @HoustonRockets :

“I’m very excited. One of the greatest players of all time coming in…I think this mix is gonna be perfect…He’llfit in beautifully.”

Rudy Tomjanovich on Kevin Durant, Jun 25, 2025. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Jrue Holiday on Kevin Durant
item.description:
“I’ve heard that there have been at least very broad discussions of three-team, Durant-related trades where Jrue Holiday is (included). I think these could be conjured by Phoenix in hopes of getting a deal done, more-or-less, where Jrue Holiday moves somewhere. Just like he was the shrapnel in the (Damian Lillard) trade and ended up in Boston.”

Jrue Holiday on Kevin Durant, Jun 22, 2025. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: Pat McAfee on Kevin Durant
item.description:
Pat McAfee:

“I think a Kevin Durant trade could happen in the next few days.. In the last 24 hours the focus has been on the Rockets, the Heat, and the Minnesota Timberwolves”

Pat McAfee on Kevin Durant, Jun 13, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: John Gambadoro on Kevin Durant
item.description:
show, Gambadoro added that it could be sooner but that his formal prediction is that Durant will be traded at some point next week.

“I expect Kevin Durant will be traded from the Phoenix Suns next week,”

John Gambadoro on Kevin Durant, Jun 12, 2025. Source: Larry Brown Sports.
